snippet.title: Singstar: Pop (2007), Official E3 2005 trailer | PS2
snippet.description:
Singstar: Pop, Video Game trailer

SingStar: Pop is a music karaoke game in the SingStar series by London Studio and published by Sony Computer Entertainment, released in 2007 to PlayStation 2 platforms.
